jobs.occupation: Data Engineer - On-site Copenhagen
jobs.description:
AI is changing how software gets built.

The data underneath it matters more than ever.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys building things properly. Someone who can move through complex systems, shape clean architecture and create the foundations modern AI workflows depend on.

You’ll work closely with engineers, AI specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you’ll work on

• 
Building modern data platforms and pipelines

• 
Creating semantic foundations for AI systems

• 
Developing AI-powered workflows and agentic systems

• 
Helping clients move AI into real operational environments

• 
Working closely with both technical teams and decision makers

• 
Shaping how modern AI infrastructure is built in practice

Requirements

You probably have experience with

• 
dbt, SnowFlake, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery or similar ecosystems

• 
SQL, Python and APIs

• 
Data modelling and warehousing

• 
GenAI, ML or MLOps workflows

• 
Complex systems and problem solving

Curiosity, taste and builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

Benefits

• 
Healthcare insurance

• 
Pension plan

• 
Parental leave

• 
Social gatherings

• 
New tech gear

• 
Central office

• 
Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• 
Skill development

• 
Paid holiday

• 
Remote work allowed

• 
Pet friendly

jobs.occupation: Client Service Associate, Danish speaker
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate, service-minded professional looking for your next opportunity with international exposure?

About the job:

We believe access to global capital markets is not only for the privileged few. Our vision is to enable people to fulfil their financial aspirations to make an impact. That is why we use the power of technology to deliver clients what they need, when they need it in a user-friendly and personalized experience.

We are looking for our next Client Service Associate to join our Client Service team located at our HQ in Copenhagen. In this role you will take part in providing first-in-class client experience in an environment where digital engagement is ever changing. We are dealing with a great variety of clients from individuals to institutional. As our new Client Service Associate, you will be assisting clients with a broad array of queries ranging from trading to funding related questions.

Our Client Service team consists of 200+ employees spread across 9 locations servicing all client types. The team’s overall purpose is to drive the global distribution and services of products towards clients of Saxo across all entities throughout the world.

A few words from our Head of Client Service, Cæcilie Marie Sommer on the role in her team:

"Working in Client Services is a great opportunity to learn about investments, build experience in the financial services industry and develop professional skills in communicating with all types of clients around the globe".

Responsibilities:

As our new Client Service Associate, you take pride in walking the extra mile to ensure that our clients’ needs and requests are fulfilled and answered. However, there are no expectations for you to be able to answer all the questions from the day one. We will provide the needed onboarding and continuously train you to be able to independently assist the clients.

Becoming a part of Client Service, you act as an ambassador for Saxo and therefor it is essential that you always thrive to deliver a best-in-class client experience and leaving the clients on a positive note.

Your tasks will include:

• Advise and assist our clients on our wide product range across all asset classes

• Act as our client facing specialist with extensive knowledge of our industry leading trading platforms

• Ensure regulatory compliance through execution of global governance

• Always act in the best interest of our clients and Saxo

• Increase client digital interaction with Saxo

Your profile:

You have great communication skills with excellence in both conveying specialist knowledge as well as simple instructions. You are motivated by clear goals and thrive with having transparent performance indicators

Moreover, we are looking for you who

• Has 2+ years of experience in a client-facing role

• Preferably have an education related to service, finance, business or similar

• Have knowledge of the financial industry and products

• Are fluent in Danish as well as English. And a third language is a plus

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: IT Audit Manager
jobs.description:
About the job

Group Internal Audit (GIA) in Saxo is responsible for carrying out risk-based operational audits across the organisation. Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, the team helps to ensure that Saxo effectively manages and mitigates the risks associated with its business activities.

We are looking for an IT Audit Manager for our team covering IT Audits across Saxo. As an IT Audit Manager within Saxo, your tasks will include auditing, analysing, and assessing IT processes within Saxo’s IT architecture, system development, operations, and security.

“This is a great opportunity to set the direction for and lead IT audits in a dynamic organisation” – Sune Andreas Yung Nielsen, Head of IT Audit.

Responsibilities

• Establish best practice audit programs for validating IT processes and controls

• Carry out audits to identify shortcomings and provide assurance on established controls

• Develop recommendations to strengthen controls and address any residual risks

• Follow up on recommendations and re-assess whether solutions are adequate

Your profile

You are known for your professionalism, integrity, and trustworthiness. You are a curious, collaborative, and outgoing person, who thrives in diverse environments.

You are comfortable communicating with management and taking the lead, and, when necessary, you are willing to challenge the status quo.

While you have great attention to detail, you still manage to maintain an overview, see through complexity, and summarise issues clearly. What matters most to us, is that you are a team player at heart, with a flexible mindset, and dare to let your personality show. You see a direct link between your own success and the overall results of GIA.

You have knowledge and hands-on experience in the following areas:

• IT Governance

• IT Risk Management

• Software Development Life Cycle

• Cyber Security

• Data Analytics

You may already have or are interested in obtaining certifications such as CISA, CISM, or CISSP.

Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.

Please note that due to the summer holiday period, responses will not be sent during July, and interviews are expected to be held in August.

We get curious people invested in the world

We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 15 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

jobs.occupation: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Senior Observability Engineer at Saxo, you will join a specialised team responsible for the bank's observability platforms. We build and continuously improve solutions that provide visibility into the performance, stability, and health of critical business systems across our hybrid infrastructure.

You will help shape the future of Saxo's observability landscape by designing and operating solutions for metrics, logs, traces, and events across cloud and on-premises environments. Your work will enable engineering teams to better understand, monitor, and improve the systems that power Saxo.

Team perspective

"We are the eyes and ears of Saxo Bank's platform health. Our work is critical to maintaining stable and continuous operations across the organisation.

Our team is based in Denmark and India and consists of five specialists. While supporting our current platforms, we are also executing our roadmap for the next generation of observability capabilities."

Responsibilities

• Own and support the day-to-day operation of Saxo's observability platform.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to deliver meaningful monitoring and visibility across business-critical systems.

• Drive priorities, technical direction, and platform improvements within the team.

• Act as the observability platform architect, ensuring scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Play a key role in delivering the next generation of Saxo's observability platform in collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and business stakeholders.

What success looks like

• Build expertise across our observability ecosystem, including Elastic, Grafana, Kibana, Kubernetes, SCOM, and Windows Server.

• Improve visibility, reliability, and operational efficiency by reducing alert noise, enhancing dashboards, and driving actionable insights.

• Define and promote standards for logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

• Collaborate with engineering, platform, and security teams to ensure observability is embedded across solutions.

• Lead incident investigations, contribute to post-mortems, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

• Optimise platform performance, scalability, and cost.

• Share knowledge through documentation, best practices, and technical guidance across the organisation.

Your profile

You have 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or a similar role, with a strong focus on observability.

You bring hands-on experience with observability technologies such as:

• Metrics: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, or similar.

• Logging: Elastic Stack, Splunk, Loki, Cloud Logging, or similar.

• Tracing: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin, X-Ray, or equivalent tracing solutions.

You also have experience with:

• SRE practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and incident management.

• Distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.

• Operating and optimising Elastic Stack in production environments.

• Grafana and Kibana for dashboarding, visualisation, and alerting.

• Windows Server administration and monitoring, ideally including SCOM.

• Public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Kubernetes, Docker, and container-based environments.

• Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitOps, etc.).

• Scripting or development experience in languages such as Java, Python, or Node.js.

We get curious people invested in the world

We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

1 Chef

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Swedish Market | Copenhagen Area or Southern Sweden
jobs.description:
Are you fluent in Swedish, based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, and ready to help ambitious restaurants grow? Join DinnerBooking and help us expand our presence in Sweden. 

At DinnerBooking, we are building a booking system that brings restaurants and guests together, and we have a lot of fun along the way. With more than 20 million guest bookings annually and 1,400+ restaurants across 11 markets, we help restaurants reach their full business potential. 

We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Sales Manager based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, for example Malmö or Lund, to grow our customer base in Sweden. You will combine your Swedish language skills and understanding of the market with a structured approach to outbound sales. 

Why join DinnerBooking? 

Besides building a fantastic product, we take pride in our culture. Your ideas matter, your opinions will be heard, and you will be part of a team that supports each other. 

We are problem solvers, colleagues, and friends who want each other to succeed, both professionally and personally. 

Your role 

You will be responsible for identifying and engaging restaurant customers in Sweden. You will join an ambitious international sales team, share ideas and work together to turn opportunities into lasting customer relationships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Identifying and contacting potential customers in the Swedish restaurant market. 

• 
Starting conversations through outbound calls, emails, and following up. 

• 
Conducting online meetings and product demonstrations in Swedish. 

• 
Managing the sales process from first contact to signed agreement. 

• 
Maintaining a structured and updated pipeline in our CRM system. 

• 
Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding for new customers. 

What you bring 

• 
You are based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, such as Malmö, Lund, or nearby areas. 

• 
Fluency in Swedish and a good command of English, both spoken and written. 

• 
At least 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience. 

• 
Confidence in opening doors, starting conversations, and building relationships. 

• 
A structured approach to managing your pipeline and following up on opportunities. 

• 
A proactive mindset and the ability to stay motivated and take ownership of your results. 

• 
An empathetic and energetic personality, with a genuine interest in people and their businesses. 

What you can expect from us 

• 
Responsibility for sales in Sweden. 

• 
An international team with strong commercial experience. 

• 
Training in our product, sales approach, and the needs of our restaurant customers. 

• 
The opportunity to make a direct impact on our growth in Sweden. 

• 
A supportive working environment with room for ideas and professional development. 

• 
A compensation package with a component based on performance. 

Interested? 

Send your application and CV in English. We would love to hear about your sales experience, your connection to the Swedish market, and why you would like to join DinnerBooking.

jobs.occupation: Analyst (Student Assistant), Talent Analytics & AI
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for an Analyst to join our Talent team based in Copenhagen.

Team

You will join the Talent team, responsible for how CIP attracts, develops and engages the people who drive our long-term success. The team combines people expertise, analytics, technology, and emerging AI capabilities to support strategic talent decisions and enable a high-performing organisation. The team's work spans talent attraction, onboarding, leadership and employee development, performance management, employee engagement, succession planning, and people analytics, ensuring CIP has the talent and capabilities needed to support its continued growth

Role

As a Talent Analytics & AI Analyst in the Talent team, you will play a key role in enabling data-driven talent and workforce decisions through analytical insights, reporting solutions, and decision materials for senior stakeholders. You will work closely with colleagues across Talent and the broader business on initiatives spanning people analytics, AI, technology, and organisational effectiveness.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work on high-impact business challenges at the intersection of people, data, and technology, making it an ideal environment for someone who thrives in analytical, fast-paced settings and is eager to contribute to talent decision-making in a global organisation. Along the way, you'll build practical experience in analytics, AI, and business decision-making while working closely with senior stakeholders across the organisation, making it an excellent stepping stone toward future roles in people analytics, Talent strategy, or broader business analytics.

The position is approximately 20-25 hours per week alongside your studies, with full flexibility around exam periods. Top performing Analysts may receive an offer to join us as full-time Associate upon graduation.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• 
Support strategic talent and workforce decisions through structured problem solving, quantitative analysis, and data-driven recommendations for senior stakeholders

• 
Develop and evolve reporting solutions, dashboards, and data products across Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint, leveraging AI-enabled approaches to enable better business decisions

• 
Apply AI, automation, and workflow technologies to streamline recurring reporting tasks, enhance insight generation, and improve turnaround time on people data requests.

• 
Contribute to strategic People & Culture initiatives through research, benchmarking, stakeholder engagement, and project implementation support.

You

We are looking for a high-performing, analytical, and intellectually curious student with strong academic credentials, proficient Excel and PowerPoint skills, a keen interest in the People space and people analytics, and a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality work.

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Psychology, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Previous experience from consulting, finance, analytics, research, student organisations, or similar analytical environments is an advantage.

We look for the following in a candidate:

Analytical & Quantitative Mindset

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges, identify key insights, and develop evidence-based recommendations.

Advanced Excel & Data Skills

• Proficient Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation and a strong interest in analytics, AI, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

Communication & Storytelling

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate analyses and insights into clear, concise, and compelling messages tailored to different audiences.

High Work Ethic & Ownership

• 
Demonstrates ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a track record of academic excellence and high-quality work while balancing multiple priorities.

• 
Academic performance will be considered as an indicator of discipline, learning agility, and work ethic.

Curiosity About People & Talent

• Genuine interest in talent, leadership, organisational effectiveness, people analytics, and the future of work.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

Building value that matters

Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – IoT Platform, Load and Energy Management
jobs.description:
🚀 About the role

We're looking for a senior software engineer who writes solid, reliable code and wants that code to control real hardware. At FLEXECHARGE, our HARMON-E platform manages load and energy for EV charging operators across Europe. Part of it runs at the edge, on an industrial PC next to chargers, batteries and solar inverters, and connected to the interfaces DSOs use to curtail load.

You'll build and maintain the TypeScript microservices that talk to those devices and turn their data into decisions. This is not a web-app role. It's software engineering for systems where the other side is physical, stateful and often unreliable.

⚡ What is special about this role

It sits where two worlds meet:

• 
Web and cloud toolchain: TypeScript, Docker, MQTT, Azure, Kubernetes.

• 
Operational technology and system integration: talking to real chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus and OCPP, running at the edge on an industrial PC.

Your code won't only talk to clean APIs in a data centre. It runs on site, next to real peripheral devices, and has to keep doing its job when those devices and the networks between them don't behave as expected.

We recognize that TypeScript is not typically used for edge computing or hardware interfacing. This is why we're looking for a strong software engineer who is interested in learning new techniques and applications, as well as applying their technical skills in novel ways.

🛠️ What you'll do

• 
Write and maintain a combination of TypeScript microservices and the business logic behind them: control algorithms, scheduling and decision-making, not just plumbing.

• 
Build and extend device drivers for chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus TCP, using our existing driver services as a starting point.

• 
Work with OCPP, which our platform already supports, as you ramp up.

• 
Run services in containers at the edge and connect them through MQTT and pub/sub messaging to our cloud backend.

• 
Profile and optimise software on edge hardware, where hardware resources are constrained.

• 
Help shape the long-term move of performance-critical services to compiled languages.

• 
Mentor and pair with colleagues on integrations and software craft.

🤔 Why compiled languages, if we write TypeScript?

It may sound odd, so here's the reasoning. Today the majority of our edge stack is TypeScript, and you'll develop in it from day one. Over time we want to move selected services, such as device interfaces and performance-critical paths, to a compiled language while keeping them part of the same stack.

To do that well, you need to understand both sides: the TypeScript services as they are now, and the concepts of memory, types and performance that compiled languages force you to think about. In our experience, it's much easier to go from a compiled language to a scripting environment than the other way around. So if you're a Go, C, C++, Rust or similar developer who is happy to work in TypeScript (or happy to learn), you're exactly who we're looking for.

✅ Must-have

• 
3–5+ years of professional software development, with strong software and engineering fundamentals.

• 
Professional experience in a compiled language (for example Go, C, C++, Rust, C# or Java).

• 
Proficiency in a scripting language, ideally TypeScript, otherwise JavaScript or Python, or a clear willingness to become productive in TypeScript quickly.

• 
Experience writing business logic with stateful calculations and operations, which can self-heal and recover gracefully.

• 
Comfort with asynchronous and event-driven systems that talk to unreliable external components or peripheral devices.

💡 Strongly preferred (but we'll teach it)

• 
Hands-on device or protocol integration: Modbus, serial interfaces, Ethernet/TCP-IP or comparable.

• 
Containerised applications. Docker, Docker Compose or Kubernetes are ideal, but any container technology counts.

• 
Pub/sub and distributed systems, ideally MQTT or another IoT messaging protocol, and an understanding of their reliability concerns.

• 
Working within constrained systems, including profiling software to find where CPU or memory limits bite.

🎁 Bonus, not a requirement

• 
OCPP experience.

• 
Energy, EV charging or power-systems domain knowledge.

• 
Edge deployment experience.

If you don't have these, apply anyway. Strong fundamentals and the right mindset matter more. 💪

🚫 This role is probably not for you if

• 
Your experience is mainly frontend or request/response web apps, with no compiled-language background.

• 
You prefer to stay in one language and aren't interested in working in TypeScript.

• 
You want a pure firmware or PLC role without writing higher-level services.

• 
You don't enjoy debugging the messy cases where hardware doesn't behave as documented.

🌆 What is it like to work at FLEXECHARGE?

• 
Our office is in Frederiksberg: bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday.

• 
You're covered with pension contributions.

• 
Lunch is served on-site, and it's delicious, healthy and nutritious.

• 
We enjoy each other's company outside work too, with Friday bars, company events and team-building activities within each team.

• 
You'll have opportunities for individual development.

🤝 Our interview process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• 
A first conversation (about 30 minutes) with our recruiter. You'll get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further.

• 
Time with the team: a conversation with Kasper, our Head of Architecture & Systems, and Robert, our CTO.

• 
A technical stage: one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• 
A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team.

Hiring carefully matters to us. We want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you.

📍 Location & practical details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen. Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• 
We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

• 
We do not offer relocation services.

🔐 Data privacy (GDPR)

Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarise interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process.

For more information or questions please contact us at iva@flexecharge.com

Working at

FLEXECHARGE

FLEXECHARGE is a cleantech scale-up which offers a powerful load & energy management platform, as a SaaS, to help Charge Point Operators (ex: Clever, eOn, etc.) to optimise their charging operations & business. Our mission is accelerate green mobility through our Smart Charging solutions that make charging faster, greener and cheaper. Our vision is to integrate charging infrastructures better with the grid supply and the ever more volatile & growing production of renewable energy. We want to connect electric vehicles with the grid in a whole new way. By seeing electric vehicles not as a risk for our supply grid, but as a crucial asset for the transition towards 100% renewable energy. We do this through constant innovation of new smart charging features which will make us the preferred partner for EV infrastructure owners, developers, and operators.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in defining the technical direction of Flatpay's online platform and helping establish the technical and architectural foundations that will support the next phase of Flatpay's growth.

This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage. While Flatpay already serves merchants at scale, our online platform is still in its early stages. You'll have the opportunity to help launch new solutions, shape how the platform evolves as adoption grows, and learn directly from customers along the way.

If you enjoy building products from the ground up, working close to customers, and seeing your work evolve from first launch to large-scale adoption, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in a domain that will play an important role in Flatpay's future growth.

What you'll do

• 
Design and build scalable systems that power online payments and commerce experiences

• 
Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• 
Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• 
Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• 
Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable online payment experiences

• 
Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• 
Partner with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to drive technical and product outcomes

• 
Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• 
Help establish engineering standards and best practices as the Online domain continues to grow

Who you are

• 
7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 
Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

•

That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic.
